title: Zephyr: TX queue priority for SOS
close_reason: Added TX_PRIORITY_SOS (P0) as highest priority in enum tx_queue_priority. Updated deadlines: SOS=2s (8 slots), ROUTING=5s (20 slots), ACK=5s (20 slots), URGENT=30s (120 slots), BULK=60s (240 slots). Added SOS case to tx_queue_push_default_deadline switch. Added 3 tests: test_sos_priority_highest, test_sos_preempts_full_queue, test_sos_default_deadline. Also fixed pre-existing issues: function signature mismatches and missing tx_queue_destroy implementation. All 22 tests pass.
